title: Executive Order No. 94, s. 2019
text:
MALACANAN PALACE
MANILA

BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 94

AUTHORIZING THE GRANT OF FINANCIAL SUPPORT TO THE
CITIZEN ARMED FORCE GEOGRAPHICAL UNIT ACTIVE
AUXILIARY SERVICE

WHEREAS, Article Il, Section 4 of the Constitution states that the
Government may call upon the people to defend the State and require citizens to
render personal military service, under conditions provided by law;

WHEREAS, Executive Order (EO) No. 264 (s. 1987) created the Citizen
Armed Forces Geographical Unit (CAFGU) which, through the mobilization of
CAFGU Active Auxiliary (CAA) units, shall complement and support the regular
forces of the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) in dealing with internal and
external security threats;

WHEREAS, in recognition of the invaluable service of the members of the
CAA units, EO No. 69 (s. 2018) granted them financial support in the amount of
Seven Thousand Pesos (P7,000.00), covering the months of November and
December 2018, and directed the Department of Budget and Management (DBM) to
study and propose measures for the continuous grant of financial support on a
monthly basis; and

WHEREAS, pursuant to EO No. 69, the DBM recommended appropriate
measures to ensure the monthly grant of finacial support to members of CAA units
in a manner that is fiscally sustainable and compliant with existing budgeting,
accounting and auditing laws, rules and regulations;

NOW, THEREFORE, I, RODRIGO ROA DUTERTE, President of the
Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by the Constitution and existing
laws, do hereby order:

Section 1. Grant of Financial Support to Qualified Members of CAA
Units. Financial support in the amount of Two Thousand Pesos (P2,000.00) per
month beginning 01 July 2019 is hereby granted to each*member of the CAA units
who meets the conditions prescribed in Section 2 of this Order.

Section 2. Coverage. Only duly-appointed members of the CAA units

appearing in the roster maintained by the AFP and actually rendering services shall
be entitled to the financial support herein set forth; provided, that those who are in

THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
 
the roster and have been appointed but are still undergoing training as of the
aforementioned date, shall be entitled to a prorated portion of said financial support
upon the satisfactory completion of the prescribed training.

Section 3. Funding. The funding requirements for the grant of financial
support to qualified members of the CAA units shall be sourced from the current
year’s available appropriations. The funding requirements for the succeeding years
shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act, subject to the submission
of the actual number of qualified CAA members to the DBM.

Section 4. Implementing Guidelines. The DBM and the Department of
National Defense shall jointly issue appropriate guidelines to implement this Order.

Section 5. Separability. If any provision of this Order is declared invalid or
unconstitutional, the remaining provisions not affected thereby shall continue to be in
full force and effect.

Section 6. Repeal. All orders, rules and regulations inconsistent with this
Order are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

Section 7. Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately.

DONE, in the City of Manila, this 8thday of November , in the year of
our Lord, Two Thousand and Nineteen

  

By the President:
